follow-up time: Through pregnancy and the neonatal period
exposure: Children born to parents with monogenic disorders conceiving without PGD
Children conceived by PGD due to parental monogenic disorder
Underlying parental condition (monogenic disorder or not)
cohort: Pregnancies following PGD (n=126), IVF/ICSI (n=30,418), and spontaneous conception (n=896,448)
finding: While PGD pregnancies had increased risks of some adverse outcomes compared to spontaneous conceptions, these risks were comparable to IVF/ICSI and were mainly related to the underlying parental condition rather than the PGD procedure itself.
